name: Work Permit (Autorisation de Travail) + Residence Permit

qualifying_event.description: A Chadian employer sponsors a foreign worker with specialized skills not readily available locally, submitting an application to the Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Employment; once approved, the Directorate General of National Security (DGSN) issues the accompanying residence permit.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Employer sponsorship; proof of specialized skills/qualifications; a valid long-stay visa held before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Employer sponsorship, with the employer demonstrating a legitimate need to hire a foreign worker and evidence of efforts to recruit locally.
Specialized skills or qualifications not readily available within the Chadian labour market.
Must hold a valid long-stay visa (visa de séjour) before applying for the work permit.

outcome.duration_length: not confirmed; processing 'several weeks to a few months' per secondary sourcing

sources.title: Rivermate (Employer-of-Record relocation guide) -- Chad work permits: Ministry of Public Service, Labour and Employment handles applications; DGSN (Directorate General of National Security) issues the residence permit after work permit approval; employer must show local-recruitment effort and the role requires skills unavailable locally; processing 'several weeks to a few months'

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Chad). STATUS: DRAFT -- entirely tier-3 sourced (a commercial Employer-of-Record relocation guide) after Chad's actual 1996 Labour Code (Code du travail, Loi n°038/PR/96) returned a 403 error on the only accessible hosting found (droit-afrique.com, itself a private legal database and would have been tier-3 even if reachable) -- flagged as a genuine sourcing gap rather than corroborated against any government or intergovernmental text. No fee, quota, or precise duration figures were found and none are stated here. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months (180 = 15 years) mirror the naturalisation residence threshold from td_citizenship_naturalisation.json since no distinct intermediate permanent-residence status was found for Chad (see td_permanent_residence.json).
